title: Fire truck
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <rect x='30' y='24' width='52' height='5' rx='2' fill='#cfd8e6'/>

  <rect x='26' y='32' width='14' height='8' rx='2' fill='#8d99ad'/>

  <rect x='12' y='40' width='60' height='30' rx='5' fill='#e03131'/>

  <circle cx='89' cy='62' r='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- bumper -->
  <rect x='70' y='68' width='24' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9d3e3'/>
  <!-- lights on top of cab -->
  <rect x='74' y='36' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4dabf7'/>
  <rect x='84' y='36' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffd43b'/>

  <circle cx='30' cy='72' r='9' fill='#4a5a75'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='72' r='4' fill='#cfd8e6'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='72' r='9' fill='#4a5a75'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='72' r='4' fill='#cfd8e6'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='72' r='9' fill='#4a5a75'/>
